meta.title: Redmine Time Tracking

sections.whyDescription: A desktop experience for teams using Redmine every day and wanting reliable, audit-ready time logs.
sections.featuresDescription: Everything you need to log faster, improve data quality, and analyze workload in one place.
sections.ctaTitle: Ready to get your time back?
sections.ctaDescription: Download Clepsydre for your OS, enable Redmine integration, and start clean tracking in minutes.

footer.builtFor: The best way to track your time.

whyCards.title: All-in-one, no Redmine needed
whyCards.description: Manage all your time entries in Clepsydre: log, edit, review history. No need to open Redmine to track time.

whyCards.title: Precise to the minute
whyCards.description: Start/end times, idle detection, manual entry: every minute is accounted for with pinpoint accuracy.

whyCards.title: Never miss an entry
whyCards.description: Daily, weekly, and timeline views: spot gaps instantly and fill them before it's too late.

whyCards.title: Total control
whyCards.description: Daily, weekly and monthly stats, filterable history: keep a clear picture of your real workload.

featureItems.title: Full timer
featureItems.description: Start, pause, stop, and reset in one click. Time your tasks effortlessly.

featureItems.title: Idle detection
featureItems.description: The app automatically detects breaks and offers to adjust the recorded time.

featureItems.title: Manual entry
featureItems.description: Enter start time, end time, and duration directly for past or planned tasks.

featureItems.title: Inline comments
featureItems.description: Add a description to each entry at the time of logging for contextualized tracking.

featureItems.title: Flexible imputation
featureItems.description: Log time on a different ticket than the active one, without leaving your work context.

featureItems.title: Ticket search
featureItems.description: Find any ticket instantly by ID, project, or title.

featureItems.title: Secure credentials
featureItems.description: Your Redmine credentials are stored in your OS secure keychain, never in plain text.

featureItems.title: Browser extensions
featureItems.description: Start the timer directly from a Redmine ticket with Chrome and Firefox extensions.

featureItems.title: Visual timeline
featureItems.description: See your day's activity at a glance on an interactive chronological timeline.

featureItems.title: Detailed statistics
featureItems.description: Daily, weekly, and monthly views to monitor your workload and spot discrepancies.

featureItems.title: Advanced history
featureItems.description: Filter, sort, and query all your past time entries to find any log instantly.

featureItems.title: Light & dark mode
featureItems.description: Interface adapted to your visual preferences, day or night.

download.whyUnsigned: Clepsydre is not code-signed yet. Each operating system will display a security warning on first launch. The steps below let you safely bypass this restriction.
windowsSteps: Download and run the .exe installer (or .msi if your environment blocks .exe files).
Windows SmartScreen will show a warning because the app is unsigned.
Complete the wizard and launch Clepsydre from the Start menu.
download.windowsTip: If launch is still blocked, check Windows Security → App & browser control and allow Clepsydre.
macosSteps: Download the DMG matching your processor.
Open Terminal and run the following command to remove the quarantine attribute:
Launch Clepsydre normally from the Launchpad or Applications.
download.macosKeychainDesc: On first launch, macOS may ask for your keychain password. Clepsydre needs access to securely store your Redmine API key. You can safely allow this.
download.linuxIntro: Choose the format that matches your distribution. AppImage works everywhere without installation; .deb and .rpm packages integrate natively with your package manager.
linuxSteps: Download the file matching your distribution from the links above.
Install or make the downloaded file executable using the commands below.
Launch Clepsydre from your app launcher or from the terminal.
download.linuxAppImageInstructions: Make the file executable and run it directly. No installation required.
download.linuxDebInstructions: Install the .deb package with apt. Dependencies are resolved automatically.
download.linuxRpmTitle: Fedora / RHEL / openSUSE — Install via rpm
download.linuxRpmInstructions: Install the RPM package using the rpm command.
download.linuxWebkitNote: On some distributions, WebKitGTK may need to be installed separately. If the app fails to launch, install it via your package manager.
download.extensionsDescription: Start the timer directly from a Redmine ticket in your browser. Extensions work right after installation, no configuration needed.
download.extensionsNoConfig: No configuration required: install the extension and it automatically detects Clepsydre on your machine.
